summaryBox.title: Rusting Cell
summaryBox.takeaway: Anode: Fe ──► Fe²⁺ + 2e⁻. Cathode: O₂ + 4H⁺ + 4e⁻ ──► 2H₂O. Rust is Fe₂O₃·xH₂O. Sacrificial anode (Mg/Zn) protects iron.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
RUSTING ELECTROCHEMICAL MECHANISM

• Anodic Site:   2Fe(s) ──► 2Fe²⁺(aq) + 4e⁻  (E° = -0.44 V)
• Cathodic Site: O₂(g) + 4H⁺(aq) + 4e⁻ ──► 2H₂O(l)  (E° = +1.23 V)
• Net Cell:      2Fe(s) + O₂(g) + 4H⁺(aq) ──► 2Fe²⁺(aq) + 2H₂O(l)  (E°_cell = +1.67 V)
• Rust Formation: 4Fe²⁺ + O₂ + 4H₂O ──► 2Fe₂O₃ + 8H⁺ ⟹ Fe₂O₃·xH₂O (Rust)
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Rusting Mechanism**: Iron acts as anode, dissolved $\text{O}_2$ in moisture droplets acts as cathode. $\text{H}^+$ is supplied by $\text{H}_2\text{CO}_3$ from atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$.
• **Cathodic Protection**: Underground pipelines are connected to sacrificial $\mathbf{\text{Mg}}$ or $\mathbf{\text{Zn}}$ blocks ($E^\circ = -2.37\text{ V}$ or $-0.76\text{ V}$), which undergo preferential oxidation.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
10 NEST TRAPS SUMMARY

1. In Galvanic cells, Anode is NEGATIVE (-).
2. Conductivity κ DECREASES with dilution.
3. E°_SHE is 0.000 V at ALL temperatures.
4. Discharging lead battery DECREASES H₂SO₄ density.
5. Mercury cell potential stays CONSTANT (1.35 V).
6. 1 Faraday = 96485 C (charge of 1 MOLE of electrons).
7. Cell constant G* units are cm⁻¹ or m⁻¹.
8. Weak electrolytes CANNOT be extrapolated to zero concentration.
9. Rusting requires BOTH O₂ AND moisture.
10. Concentration cell has E°_cell = 0.
